title: RPI inflation
headline: A quarter of government debt is index-linked, so RPI feeds straight into interest.
description: How much higher or lower RPI inflation is than the OBR assumed, sustained across the forecast. About a quarter of government debt is index-linked, so RPI feeds straight into debt interest.

baselinePolicy.text: OBR October 2026: CPI inflation 3.1% in 2026 and 3.4% in 2027, then about 2% a year; RPI 3.6% and 4.3%, running above CPI.

control.formatLabel: percentage points versus the OBR assumption

considerations.text: Higher inflation raises the interest paid on index-linked gilts at once, and reaches benefit uprating and public pay with a lag. The OBR puts one point more RPI at £9 billion more on the current budget deficit in 2029-30 and £11 billion in 2031-32; it does not split the channels out.
